scope: Limited manual review of 20 named/hash-verified rest, skeleton, moderate-bend and paired deep-joint views. No game-motion, appearance or production qualification.
observations: The integrated shoulder/hip pivot candidate reduces 90-degree shoulders 131/81 to 44/35 and hips 255/133 to 51/47 versus the immutable taper. Skin weights and rest surface are preserved. All 16 bends have zero severe-stretch edges; forearms remain 0/0 and calves 0/2.

Selected front, back, side and skeleton bind views preserve the overall silhouette and supported feet. Selected 45-degree arm/leg front views show the intended independent limb movement without gross collapse.

Paired 90-degree oblique shoulder views retain a compressed/rounded transition at the shoulder root. Paired hip views and current side views retain abrupt creases and joint-root shape changes. Lower contact counts do not clear the deformation gate.

Front close hip views have foreground leg occlusion. They show part of the hip/groin transition but cannot independently clear every remaining contact. The exact source-bound map identifies 208 residual contact vertices, including same-region folds and groin/opposite-thigh contacts.

Both exported diagnostic GLBs reproduce all 16 saved counts; 68 screenshots rendered without browser errors. Only the 20 listed images were manually assessed. These are diagnostic clips, not game animations.

A separate evaluation-only preserve-volume diagnostic on this exact source improves some joints but worsens right-hip contacts 47 to 67. It is not a portable glTF correction and is not applied to this native GLB.
decision: Retain this as the strongest measured native-GLB diagnostic, preserve all immutable baselines and keep qualification/publication false. Further pivot or transfer tuning is not a demonstrated shape repair. Next isolate a targeted joint-surface/pose-corrective solution on the 208 source-bound vertices, requiring exact GLB reimport and Babylon evidence before the real motion pipeline.
